- **Chat and notes now span the whole draft match** (issue #463): a conversation/note started during game 1 of a best-of-three draft match is still there in game 2, and both are now usable during the drafting/deck-building phase itself, not just once a game is in progress.
- **Open Games dialog**: fixed listings showing the raw internal name for a deck type (e.g. "Draft – sealed_deck") whenever it lacked a display label; Sealed Deck also drops the "Draft –" prefix since it has no actual drafting phase.
- Process fix: `development` → `main` promotion PRs now include a curated release-notes file, so this announcement (and future ones) stays a short bullet summary instead of falling back to a raw commit list.
